entries.text: Analyzer diagnostics for types declared in referenced assemblies are deliberately not reported: their authors cannot act on them.
Generated files under tests/**/Snapshots/*.verified.cs are verified by regeneration, never hand-edited.

citations.claim: The analyzer silently skips closed generic structs from referenced assemblies without reporting a diagnostic.
